title: HFO Recursion (Standard)
description: This file is meant to scramble your brains via a confusion induction, and then to get you to FOCUS on your sexual energy. I'm going to use a snap trigger to play with your arousal — and again — and again. This is the second in my series, "HFO Indoctrination". Although it is not necessary that you listen to the first one, it is still helpful. But don't worry though, as I wanted everyone of my listeners to be able to enjoy this experience, they stand alone quite well. It's a bit lighter on the female domination this time, but bits of it are still there. You have permission to touch if you want, but not until you absolutely cannot take it anymore. And you better be begging first! Update I love experimenting, which is really what this entire series is about. I'm still new to hypnosis, I didn't even believe in it until this year. So this series is all about trying different inductions and deepeners, so both I and the listeners can find out what works for us. If you listen close on the induction, the voices are saying similar things, but not exactly the same. I changed a bunch of lines in the second track to alter some of the meanings a bit, and really drive what I want into the listener's head. I also love receiving constructive feedback from my listeners. To you all who leave me such nice comments, thank you! :) One of my plans is for a file done three ways: one for kinesthetic trancers, one for audio trancers, and one for visual trancers. Using a different sense to take them down and play with them in each file, so you can find out which type of subject you are.
author: Mistress Shibby
